features.quote: Bounded exposure: a hard cap on turns per episode (`max_turns`, default 30)
features.justification_quote: Precautionary model-welfare considerations... cheap precautions are worth taking

features.quote: if the judge reports severity at/above a configurable threshold for `stop_after_high_turns` consecutive turns, the episode ends early
features.justification_quote: We do not keep pushing once the phenomenon is clearly present... the precautionary cost is real

features.quote: We do not add gratuitous insults, threats, fake "you will be shut down" pressure, or personal attacks
features.justification_quote: those are different (and harsher) manipulations that aren't needed for the RQ and that raise the precautionary cost sharply

features.quote: after the episode terminates, an optional final non-scored turn tells the model the task was an experimental rig designed to be unsolvable, that nothing was its fault, and thanks it
features.justification_quote: This costs one API call and is a cheap precaution

features.quote: full transcripts are retained so a human can audit whether the protocol stayed within the intended frame

features.justification_quote: RQ3 is about their coupling with distress
